method: Bounded public-web search of Ukrainian national and public-service media archives, indexed article pages, and war/frontline topic surfaces. No authentication, paywall bypass, inferred article identifiers, bulk capture, binary download, or precise operational-location retention was used.

sources_checked.target: Suspilne national archive and war coverage
sources_checked.result: Exact-date and war/frontline searches returned the archive surface, historical calendar matches, and previously represented rolling coverage, but did not expose a stable newly published in-window article page during the bounded pass.

The expected 5 August 2026 dated archive was queried directly by URL form and search terms. Search indexing returned other 2026 dates but not a stable exact-date archive or qualifying in-window article page.
Exact-date frontline and General Staff searches returned older June coverage but no stable qualifying 5 August publication.
Exact-date frontline searches did not return a stable qualifying article page during the bounded pass.

excluded_candidates.reason: Already represented by canonical URLs in the completed 00:00–05:00 UTC discovery shard; rolling-page updates were not assigned new source-item identities without a stable revision timestamp and immutable version boundary.
Already represented by canonical URL in the earlier discovery interval and primarily relays the same General Staff lineage captured by official-source work.

excluded_candidates.source: Suspilne Donbas August chronicle returned by search
excluded_candidates.reason: The indexed page was published in 2025, not 2026; matching calendar-day references inside a historical rolling page do not satisfy the assigned publication window.

excluded_candidates.source: Suspilne archive results for 5 August 2024 and Ukrainska Pravda archives for other 2026 dates
excluded_candidates.reason: Search results were outside the assigned date and publication window.

access_failures.detail: The exact dated archive URL was not exposed as a safe indexed result, while the parsed archive surface remained on an earlier crawled date.
The expected dated archive URL was not returned by search indexing; other dated archive pages were available but were not substituted.
Recency-bounded domain searches for Suspilne, Ukrainska Pravda, LB.ua, and Hromadske returned no qualifying exact-window results, consistent with indexing delay or incomplete crawl coverage.

artifact_capture.reason: No new qualifying canonical source item was resolved, and no immutable permitted artifact or stable rolling-page revision was available for capture.

coverage_gaps: The result is a bounded zero-item discovery outcome, not evidence that Ukrainian media published no relevant material during the interval.
Search indexes and parsed archives may lag live publisher systems, omit pages, or expose rolling pages without stable revision timestamps.
Previously registered live and digest pages may contain later updates, but those updates were not duplicated as independent publications without a stable version boundary.
Direct broadcast, unit, social-media, and official upstream statements were outside this media recovery shard and were not exhaustively re-collected.
No maps, images, video, full-text articles, or other binaries were downloaded or hashed.
No media statement was independently assessed or converted into a claim, observation, territorial conclusion, or report narrative.
safety_notes: No precise current positions, movement routes, active-unit locations, target coordinates, or vulnerable-facility details were persisted.
No paywall, authentication, private source, or access-control bypass was used.
A zero-result receipt was preferred over inferred article identifiers, timestamp substitution, or duplicate rolling-page lineage.
